```js
export const __rspack_esm_ids = ["main"];
export const __webpack_modules__ = {
"./holder.js"(__unused_rspack_module, __webpack_exports__, __webpack_require__) {
__webpack_require__.r(__webpack_exports__);
__webpack_require__.d(__webpack_exports__, {
  load: () => (load)
});
function load() {
	return __webpack_require__.e(/* import() | mod */ "mod").then(__webpack_require__.bind(__webpack_require__, "./mod.js"));
}


},

};
export const __rspack_esm_runtime = function(__webpack_require__) {
// webpack/runtime/get_full_hash
(() => {
__webpack_require__.h = () => ("CURRENT_HASH")
})();

}
;

```
